title: Pierside operator dashboard
description: Bookings, PayPal deposits and rate-card accuracy from pierside-job-history (seeded demo jobs + sandbox bookings).

config.content:
### Pierside operator dashboard
Jobs marked `demo` are **seeded demo data** generated from the rate card, not real customers. Paid sandbox bookings join them through the after_payment Render Workflow, and the operator's actual dive hours and findings land at dive complete. Every panel is one ES|QL query over `pierside-job-history`, the same index the booking agent searches for similar past jobs.

data_source.query: FROM pierside-job-history | STATS quotes = COUNT(*), paid = COUNT(deposit) | EVAL conversion = paid / quotes::double
FROM pierside-job-history | STATS deposits = SUM(deposit), paid = COUNT(deposit)

config.title: Dive hours over the rate card

data_source.query: FROM pierside-job-history | WHERE status == "completed" AND actual_hours IS NOT NULL | STATS overrun = SUM(actual_hours) / SUM(est_hours) - 1, dives = COUNT(*)
FROM pierside-job-history | WHERE deposit IS NOT NULL | STATS deposits = SUM(deposit) BY month = DATE_TRUNC(1 month, date) | SORT month

config.title: Jobs by asset: paid vs quote only

data_source.query: FROM pierside-job-history | EVAL outcome = CASE(deposit IS NOT NULL, "paid deposit", "quote only") | STATS jobs = COUNT(*) BY asset_type, outcome

config.title: Rate card vs actual dive hours, by water conditions

data_source.query: FROM pierside-job-history | WHERE status == "completed" AND actual_hours IS NOT NULL | STATS dives = COUNT(*), rate_card_h = SUM(est_hours), actual_h = SUM(actual_hours) BY visibility, fouling | EVAL overrun = actual_h / rate_card_h - 1 | SORT overrun DESC
